t: Decisions keeps a log of what your team decided, and the action items: who does what, by when.
In this video, you will learn how to find decisions and action items, record a new one, and mark one done.
Click Work in the left menu, then Decisions.
The numbers show decisions, open action items, overdue ones, and yours to do.
Each one shows its owner, where it came from, a chat or a meeting, and the date. Click the source to go there.
Filter by decisions or action items, where they came from, team and time, or search.
Press Add. Choose decision or action item, write what was decided, and pick the owner and due date.
You can also record one straight from a chat message, with the scales button, or from a meeting.
Next in the Work menu: Who owns a decision.
